provenance: the offline twin of live-ol-search-a11y-invisible (M6 eval-first batch, report 20260817-024235). On openlibrary.org the search field is invisible to both the a11y tree and the light DOM; the relocation ladder 'rescued' the locate failure onto the literal text 'Search' — a non-fillable element — and the ensuing Locator.fill error was classified `act`. Root cause locate, reported act, diagnosis 0/1. This fixture reproduces the laundering shape without the live dependency: shop.html's exact-text match for 'Search' is the submit BUTTON (the input's label reads 'Search products'), so a text-tier fill lands on a control that can never accept a value.

triage.what_this_grades: the failure class, not the search. Filling an element that cannot hold a value means the resolver returned the wrong element — that is a locate failure however Playwright phrases the error. Reporting it as `act` steers the act ladder (re-observe -> replan) at a problem the locate ladder (re-observe -> different tier) owns, and inflates the act family in every distribution the analysis reports.
triage.watched_red: today: failure:act. Wanted: failure:locate, with the relocation ladder free to try another tier and the class surviving if none of them is fillable either.
triage.scope_note: the guard belongs in the executor's fill path, not in the relocation rung: a first-attempt plan that targets a non-fillable element is the same defect, and only the sibling callers of a shared guard are safe from it.
